description:
ClearCommands

Manual Download
Requires Console Commands

Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS
Older versions and changelogs

Or support me on Ko-Fi

A small amount of additional console commands to clear the fleet bloat that seems to be affecting many saves.
Safe to add and remove to an ongoing save file.

Might be able to fix your game if:

Your game is stuttering
You have extremely low fps
You are unable to save
You are crashing when hovering over certain fleets

Try [csmartClear] before using the more direct deletion commands!
If you are getting the "crashing when mousing over a fleet" problem, use [cclearModularShips]!

Commands
cfleetReport
Displays a report with information on the fleets currently in the game. This is useful to monitor the worst offenders of fleet bloat, and might be useful when checking for the cause of stutter.

cfleetReport <FactionID>
Displays a report with information on the specific faction fleets. Mostly useful to get more info if a specific faction is misbehaving.

csmartClear
Checks for factions with abnormal fleet count, and tries to clear them while attempting to skip any fleets with an impact on the campaign experience. Excludes stations, bounties, quest fleets, fleets with the "orbiting" assignment, trading fleets, and task forces.

cclearAllFleets
Clears all fleets in the sector. Excludes stations, bounties and quest fleets (if they are marked important). This is the nuclear option, use with caution.

cclearFleets <FactionID>
Clears the fleets of a specific faction. Requires either the Faction ID or the Faction name as argument. Excludes stations, bounties and quest fleets (if they are marked important).

listNearbyFleets [range]
Lists all Fleets and their fleet members in the star system. If a range is specified, lists them in the range in the star system. Denotes modular ships as such when listing them.

cclearModularShips [all/allWithStations]
Clears all modular ships with the VariantSource.REFIT in the star system (https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=19655.0). Excludes player fleet, stations, bounties and quest fleets (if they are marked important). With [all], clears every modular ship in the star system, regardless of refit source (still excludes the above). With [allWithStations], also clears station fleets (does not destroy the station entity).

For Modders
You can exempt a fleet from being cleared by setting the fleet memory key (boolean) [$clearCommands_no_remove].
Works on all commands in here.
Use this sparingly, we do not know the source of the problem yet.

Change Log
Changelog post 1.0.g to be found here.

Older versions
1.0.f Adjusted - Added defending fleets to the exception list for cSmartClear
Adjusted - Added fleets that are tagged to be ignored by other fleets to the exception list for cSmartClear
Adjusted - Accounted for fleets with unique ships and ships with a forced loadout (likely mod-added bounties) to not be cleared by any command
Fixed - No longer clears Seeker bosses

1.0.e Fixed - No longer clears Ziggurat Fleet

1.0.d Adjusted - updated for 0.95a

1.0.b Added - csmartClear - clears any abnormal fleet counts while trying to cause minimal impact on the game
Added - cfleetReport <FactionID> (displays detailed, faction specific report)
Added - cfleetReport now displays listeners
Added - Fleet Report now reports routes by dynamic categories (Sometimes sorts wrong).
Added - memory key to exclude fleet from being cleared [$clearCommands_no_remove]
Adjusted - Fleet Report formatting
Adjusted - Report now displays faction IDs
Fixed - Some inaccuracy

Credit
Iridescens
listNearbyFleets and cclearModularShips command code, thanks for the contribution!

discordPostHtml:
A small set of additional console commands for save file cleanup.

Might be able to fix your game if:

  • Your game is stuttering
  • You have extremely low fps
  • You are unable to save
  • You are crashing when hovering over certain fleets

ALWAYS save a copy before using any of the commands provided by this mod.

Try [csmartClear] before using the more direct deletion commands!
If you are getting the "crashing when mousing over a fleet" problem, use [cclearModularShips]!

Changelog: 
> Version patch, excluded some quest factions from csmartclear
> Made cSmartClear slightly more robust and less prone to murdering quest fleets
> Fixed it clearing the seeker bosses
+ SAVE COMPATIBLE with any prior version
+ CAN be installed on an ongoing save
+ CAN be safely removed from an ongoing save
This means: The mod can be added if it was not present on game start, the update is safe to install over the old one if you had a prior version, and you can remove the mod at any time.

Download

Forum Thread

Support my Efforts

_________________________________

Now with 100% less softlocking quests.
aiDescription: Provides diagnostic tools to report on fleet counts and specific factions. Includes commands to safely clear abnormal fleets, all fleets, or specific faction fleets while excluding important entities like stations and quest fleets. Designed to resolve stuttering, low FPS, and crashes caused by save file bloat.
